title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final average energy for 4 electrons as E = 15.5 eV.

title: Energy Level Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state the energy level formula E_n = E_1 n^2.

title: Application of Pauli's Principle
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Pauli's exclusion principle correctly to determine the distribution of electrons in energy levels.

title: Calculation of E1
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive or state the correct value of E1 based on the potential well parameters.

title: Average Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the average energy using the formula E = (1/N) Σ E_i for the electrons.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all energy values are expressed in consistent units (eV).

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the number of electrons in each energy level.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in energy calculations, particularly when applying the exclusion principle.
